paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: DarkSide-50 (12306 kg d LAr exposure) sets new 90% C.L. limits on multiple channels: DM-electron cross section, axioelectric coupling gAe, dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, and sterile neutrino mixing. I selected AxionElectron (gAe) per the pre-analysis hint; the paper states stronger direct-detection limits on gAe for masses between 0.03 keV and 0.2 keV, with the analysis range 0.06-21 keV_er. No numerical table or explicit gAe values appear in the text; limits are only in Fig. 2, which is not machine-readable here. The listed data_points are APPROXIMATE values reconstructed from knowledge of the published exclusion curve (roughly flat at few x 10^-13 over ~0.06-20 keV) and should be verified against the figure/HEPData. Standard Halo Model assumed with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, v_esc = 544 km/s, v_0 = 238 km/s. Confidence reduced because coupling values are not directly extractable from the provided content and the paper covers multiple coupling types. | selector: none over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.45, 7))
